preamble.summary: 1 Samuel 18 continues the David-and-Saul cycle with the song of the women, Saul's spear-throwing, and Michal's marriage. The LXX again preserves a shorter form (omitting vv. 1–5, 10–11, 17–19); 4QSamᵃ's fragmentary support tends toward the longer MT form.
preamble.notable_variants: Continuation of the chapter 17 textual question. LXX shorter form omits material; 4QSamᵃ's fragmentary readings support the longer MT-type text.
